summary: Rider Space v2 (section 6.8) end-to-end verified. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass in test_rider_v2.py — rider login (role=rider), /delivery-templates returns 4 WA templates + proof settings + score weights (PATCH admin/manager only, 403 for rider), /riders/me/today returns orders/counts/to_collect/collected/balance_to_hand_over, /riders/me/history masks customer.phone (phone_masked = '07 •• •• •• XX'), status→en_livraison on COD generates 4-digit delivery_code via secrets.randbelow and is idempotent (no regen), POST /orders/{id}/deliver with method=code returns 401 'Code invalide (N/3)' on wrong code, locks on 3rd attempt → 4th returns 423 'verrouillée', correct code marks status=livree + proof.code_verified=true, method=photo requires photo+signature, high-value ≥50000 FCFA requires valid manager_pin (403 PIN required / 403 PIN invalide / 200 with PIN 1234), low value doesn't need PIN, method=thirdparty requires thirdparty_name (400 without), contact-log appends {kind:'whatsapp',template_key:'en_route'} to order.contact_log, /riders/{id}/score returns score(0-100)+level+weights+components(5 keys)+stats, /riders/{id}/reviews hides hidden reviews for rider self and strips customer.phone (only first_name+quartier), PATCH /users/me/photo persists photo URL on user, PATCH /users/me/prefs persists under prefs and strips role/password_hash, PATCH /reviews/{id}/moderate is admin/manager only (403 for rider). Frontend: After fix (see 'updated_files'), rider login now redirects to /rider (NOT /console/livreur). All 5 bottom tabs render (rider-tab-courses|carte|historique|performance|profil). Courses page shows KPIs + 7 filter chips (filter-all|a_livrer|en_route|livrees|annulees|reportees|echecs) + rider-scan button. Carte: rider-map LeafletMap + map-filter-todo + map-optimize. Historique: 4 periods (hist-period-1|7|30|90) + 5 status tabs (hist-tab-toutes|livrees|annulees|reportees|echecs). Performance: rider-score shows '80 / Or', 5 progress bars perf-delivery_rate|punctuality|rating|cash|proof. Profil: profil-photo file input, theme-light|dark|auto buttons, wa-standard|wa-business toggle, profil-call-manager|profil-wa-manager|profil-report CTAs. Theme toggle actually adds html.dark class. No console errors on any route.
action_items: App.js had TWO blocking bugs preventing /rider from EVER being reachable by riders — I fixed both: (a) line 61 Protected() wrapper redirected rider→/console/livreur, which contradicted the spec AND created a loop since (b) /rider route was itself wrapped in <Protected>, so a rider could never reach /rider. Changed /rider wrapper to <ProtectedRider> and changed the role-based redirect target to /rider. Main agent must verify this is the intended final behaviour; the OLD /console/livreur (<Rider/>) route is still registered and may now be unreachable from UI (dead code).
Consider deleting /console/livreur route + legacy Rider component since RiderShell at /rider is the canonical rider UI per spec 6.8.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js: /rider route was <Protected> which redirects rider→elsewhere, making it impossible for a rider to reach the new RiderShell — classic contradictory guard. Any role-gated route for a specific role should use a role-matched guard, never the generic one.
server.py /orders has no GET /orders/{oid} single-order endpoint — had to GET /orders and filter in tests. Minor DX issue; consider adding @api.get('/orders/{oid}').

server.py line 710: punctuality is HARDCODED to 90 in /riders/{id}/score (comment acknowledges 'approximate 90%'). This makes the component meaningless for ranking riders. Should compute from order.timeline en_livraison→livree duration vs créneau, or at least from timeline punctuality metric. Suggest adding a TODO or a feature flag that hides this component until real.

server.py /orders/{oid}/status PATCH generates delivery_code but does NOT verify order has payment_method=cod OR customer phone before generating — the enqueue is skipped if no phone digits but code is still written. Minor: should guard the whole block on phone presence (user-facing: 'why do I have a code with no SMS?').

DeliveryTemplatesIn model allows arbitrary partial PATCH — PATCH /delivery-templates fully replaces delivery_templates sub-document (uses $set with body.model_dump()). If admin PATCHes just {proof_threshold: 60000}, wa_templates/code_sms_text may be wiped. Confirmed by model=full dump including defaults, but any field with None default could clobber. Suggest $set per-field or merge.

/users/me/prefs stores the entire body under prefs — the test confirms role/password_hash are stripped BEFORE persisting (good), but ANY other arbitrary key (e.g. {admin:true} or large base64 blob) is accepted. Consider whitelisting {theme, wa, sound, language, notifications}.
RiderShell.jsx watches geolocation every mount and POSTs to /riders/location every 20s — no cleanup toast/error, battery impact. Also no permission-denied UX fallback.

RiderShell theme persists in localStorage BUT also user prefs via PATCH /users/me/prefs are not synced to localStorage on login — a rider setting dark mode on phone A will see light on phone B. Low priority.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 5 tabs + all 35 data-testids verified + theme toggle)

rca_of_the_issue: Compile OK but functional dead-end: Main agent built the whole /rider nested route tree + RiderShell + 5 pages, but forgot to update the global <Protected> wrapper (line 61) that still forced rider→/console/livreur. Compounded by wrapping /rider in <Protected> itself (should be <ProtectedRider>), creating a logical impossibility (rider never reaches /rider). First browser test caught it immediately — URL ended in /console/livreur after login, old 4-tab Rider.jsx rendered. Fixed both lines; second run confirms every data-testid in the spec renders correctly and score=80/Or renders live from GET /api/riders/{id}/score.
